description: Load a stored F5 configuration (SCF) onto a node: upload in parts, tidy, verify, merge or replace, wait for the F5, save.
changelog: Waits for the F5 to answer again after applying, and retries the save on 500/502/503: a real 17.5 production export restarted the REST service during the merge and 1.2's save got HTTP 502 Proxy Error.
